snippet.title: CRIMSON FREEDOM | OFFICIAL GAMEPLAY TRAILER
snippet.description:
Crimson Freedom is a gripping real-time strategy game focused on single player experience. Set on 22nd-century Mars, the game follows the epic struggle of ideologies battling for supremacy over the red planet and the future of humanity. With base building, army management, resource systems, compelling campaigns, and strong, distinctive factions, our game delivers the pure RTS experience, enhanced with modern looks and thoughtful innovations. No gimmicks, just the timeless strategy you expect, done right.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3973160?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer
Discord: https://discord.gg/A9Gjkzvf5s 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/crimsonfreedomgame/
